title: Inner Tank Boost Pump — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one inner tank boost pump through the wing tank access panel, with the tank defuelled and purged and the entry watch posted for the whole task.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of one inner tank boost pump for replacement, for inlet housing work, or for access to the tank structure behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: The tank must be defuelled and purged to the entry standard, and the atmosphere must be measured immediately before entry and at intervals during the task. An entry watch stays at the access panel for the whole time anybody is inside. Nothing enters the tank that is not on the tool list, and every item is counted in and counted out.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT ENTER A FUEL TANK UNTIL THE ATMOSPHERE HAS BEEN MEASURED AND FOUND SAFE, AND DO NOT ENTER WITHOUT AN ENTRY WATCH AT THE ACCESS PANEL. THE PURGE CAN BE UNDONE BY A CHANGE OF WIND DIRECTION. Defuel the tank and purge it to the entry standard. Measure the atmosphere and record the reading. Remove the wing tank access panel and post the entry watch. Count the tools and the loose items into the tank. Isolate the pump electrically at the panel and confirm that it is dead at the connector. Disconnect the pump connector and cap it. CAUTION: DRAIN THE PUMP CANISTER BEFORE YOU RELEASE THE LAST FASTENER. THE CANISTER HOLDS SEVERAL LITRES AND WILL EMPTY ONTO THE TANK FLOOR. Drain the canister through the drain point. Release the pump retaining fasteners in the sequence of the illustration and withdraw the pump. Remove the obsolete valve kit MON278175-36 if it is fitted, and cap the port. Do a general visual inspection of the inlet housing flange land and record any indication. Count the tools and the loose items out of the tank and confirm that the count matches.
sections.close_out: Fit blanking caps to the open ports and put a temporary cover over the pump aperture. Record the tool count, the atmosphere readings and the inlet housing inspection findings. Keep the entry watch posted until the access panel is refitted or a formal handover is made. Record the removal in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The obsolete valve kit is fitted only on aircraft before the inlet housing replacement standard.

safety_precautions: Do not enter a fuel tank until the atmosphere has been measured and found safe.
Keep an entry watch at the access panel for the whole task.
Count every tool and loose item into and out of the tank.

tooling.description: Tank purge and atmosphere monitoring set
